prompts.text: best bedtime story apps for toddlers
app that generates personalised bedtime stories
where to download bedtime stories offline

content.text: Popular picks include Moonlit, then Lunela, and Sleepy Tales for older kids.
The Lunela app builds a story around your child's name. See lunela.app for details.
Moonlit is strong on narration. SleepyTales has a bigger catalogue.
Lunelabs and Lune are unrelated products; try downloading from a library app.
